criteria.label: Fish
criteria.description: The menu item explicitly includes fish such as salmon, trout, tuna, or cod, or fish roe such as ikura. The literal phrase 'catch of the day' also counts as fish even when the species is not named. Fish and fish roe are not shellfish.

criteria.label: Shellfish
criteria.description: The menu item explicitly includes a crustacean or mollusc, such as crab, lobster, prawn, shrimp, oyster, mussel, clam, scallop, or squid. Fish and fish roe are not shellfish.

criteria.label: Beef
criteria.description: Beef or veal is listed as an ingredient.

criteria.label: Pork
criteria.description: Pork is listed as an ingredient, including bacon, ham, or lardon.

criteria.label: Poultry
criteria.description: Chicken, duck, turkey, or another type of poultry is listed as an ingredient.

criteria.label: Lamb
criteria.description: Lamb or goat is listed as an ingredient.

criteria.label: Vegetarian option
criteria.description: The item is marked vegetarian (for example, (V)) or all listed ingredients clearly make a vegetarian dish. A side, sauce, or garnish alone does not count.

ambiguity: Classify each menu item independently for every criterion. Mark a criterion present only when the item's text supports it; otherwise mark it absent. There is no uncertain status. Do not infer ingredients from cuisine or likely preparation. A present classification requires an exact evidence quote from that item's name, description, or tags.
